questions.question: What is the speaker trying to make low calorie?
questions.explanation: 原句提到'the low calorie on set does not make...'，说明说话者是在片场（on set）尝试做某种低卡路里的东西，但效果不好。'on set'是影视行业的常用表达，指拍摄现场。

questions.question: Where did the speaker go based on the subtitle 'I literally went to the Oval Office'?
questions.explanation: Oval Office（椭圆办公室）是美国总统的正式办公场所，位于白宫西厢。说话者使用'literally'（真的，确实）来强调自己真的去了那里。

questions.question: What time is it according to the speaker?
questions.explanation: 原句'Now it's like 9.30'意思是'现在大概9点半了'。'like'在这里表示'大约、差不多'，是非正式口语中常用的表达方式。

questions.question: What did the speaker get?
questions.explanation: 原句'I got a pair of socks'意思是'我买了一双袜子'。'a pair of'是表示成对物品的量词，常用于袜子、鞋子、手套、眼镜等。

questions.question: What type of greeting is 'Alright, what's up everyone'?
questions.explanation: 'What's up'是一个非常口语化、非正式的问候方式，类似于中文的'大家好'或'最近怎么样'。'Alright'是vlogger常用的开场词，表示'好的、那么'。

questions.question: Where is the speaker after returning?
options: B) At the warehouse, in their room
questions.explanation: 原句'now I am back at the warehouse In my room room'说明说话者回到的是仓库（warehouse）里的房间。这是vlogger常见的生活/工作空间。

questions.question: Where is the speaker when they say 'I'm on the Air Force One now'?
options: B) On the US President's airplane
questions.explanation: Air Force One（空军一号）是美国总统的专机，无论现任总统乘坐哪架飞机，那架飞机的呼号就叫Air Force One。说话者能登上此机，表明身份特殊。

questions.question: Why does the speaker think walking through the tunnel will be fun?
options: A) Because they like dark places
B) Because they have never done it before and it sounds exciting
D) Because their friends are there
questions.explanation: 原句'I think walking through the tunnel is going to be so much fun'使用了'going to'表示对未来的预期，'so much fun'强调这件事非常有趣。说话者对这次经历充满期待。

questions.question: What does 'I had the best time of my entire life today' express?
questions.explanation: 'the best time of my entire life'是英语中表达极度开心和满足的强烈方式，意思是'我人生中最美好的时光'。'entire life'强调从出生到现在的所有时间。

questions.question: What does the idiom 'soak it all in' mean?
options: B) To fully experience and appreciate the moment
questions.explanation: 'soak it all in'是一个英语习语，字面意思是'把一切都吸收/浸泡'，实际含义是'充分感受、体验并享受当前时刻'。常用于描述难得或特别的经历。

questions.question: What does 'grab a Diet Coke' mean in this context?
options: A) To steal a Diet Coke
B) To go get/purchase a Diet Coke quickly
C) To hold a Diet Coke tightly
D) To throw away a Diet Coke
questions.explanation: 'grab'在口语中意为'快速拿到、迅速获取'，常用于去买食物或饮料的场合。'grab a Diet Coke'意思是'去拿一瓶健怡可乐'，是一种随意、非正式的表述。

questions.question: According to the video, who had this special item?
options: B) Only Team USA players and some Whoop members
questions.explanation: 原句'Only Team USA players and some Whoop members had this'明确说明拥有该物品的两类人：美国队队员和一些Whoop（一个健康追踪设备品牌）会员。'Only'强调排他性。

questions.question: What is a 'root beer'?
options: B) A sweet, carbonated soft drink
questions.explanation: Root beer（根汁汽水）是一种北美流行的甜味碳酸饮料，通常不含酒精，由多种植物根部和香料制成。'from the machine'说明是从自动售货机买的。

questions.question: What does 'I'm finally back after a long day' convey?
options: A) The speaker is just starting their day
B) The speaker has completed a tiring day and is returning home
C) The speaker is going on a trip
D) The speaker is at the beginning of a project
questions.explanation: 'finally back'表示终于回来了，'a long day'指漫长的一天。这个表达传达了说话者经历了疲惫的一天后终于回到家的轻松感。

questions.question: What does 'I'm exhausted' mean?
questions.explanation: 'exhausted'是形容词，意为'筋疲力尽的、疲惫不堪的'，比'tired'程度更深。说话者累了所以换上睡衣（pajamas）准备休息。

questions.question: What is the speaker planning to do with grandpa?
options: B) Go play golf at the golf course
questions.explanation: 原句'downstairs to meet grandpa to go to the golf course with him and play golf'清楚说明说话者下楼去见爷爷，然后一起去高尔夫球场打高尔夫球。

questions.question: What does 'chilling right now' mean in this context?
options: B) Relaxing and taking it easy
questions.explanation: 'chilling'在年轻人口语中意为'放松、悠闲地待着'，与'working hard'相对。'right now'强调当前状态。这是当代英语中非常流行的非正式表达。

questions.question: In golf, what is a 'birdie'?
options: B) A score of one stroke under par on a hole
questions.explanation: 在高尔夫中，'birdie'（小鸟球）是指某洞用比标准杆少一杆的成绩，是好成绩的标志。原句'Wow, four birdies'表示说话者在四洞中各打出了小鸟球。

questions.question: What does the speaker mean by 'I'm exhausted, but gotta grind'?
options: A) They're going to sleep immediately
B) Despite being tired, they must continue working hard
C) They're going to make coffee
questions.explanation: 'gotta'是'got to'的口语缩写，意为'必须'。'grind'在俚语中意为'努力工作、奋斗'。整句表达了'虽然累但仍需努力'的坚持精神。

questions.question: What event is happening on 'day two' according to the speaker?
questions.explanation: 原句'It's day two, which is the Ryder Cup day'说明第二天是莱德杯（Ryder Cup）比赛日。Ryder Cup是欧美两队之间两年一度的高尔夫球对抗赛。

questions.question: What is the weather like when the speaker goes to play golf?
questions.explanation: 原句'it's kind of cold not really'以及'besides that'（除了那个之外），结合上下文可知天气有点冷。'kind of'在口语中表示'有点、稍微'。

questions.question: Describe what you think happened when the speaker went to the Oval Office. How might you feel if you visited such an important place?
questions.explanation: 这是一道开放式口语题，要求学生根据视频内容推测在椭圆办公室的经历。Oval Office是美国总统的正式办公室，位于白宫内，是美国权力中心的象征。能进入这里是非常难得的经历。
questions.referenceAnswer: I imagine the speaker felt very excited and honored to visit the Oval Office. It's the official office of the US President in the White House. If I visited such an important place, I would feel nervous but also thrilled. I would probably look around carefully and take mental notes of every detail, including the famous Resolute Desk and the artwork on the walls. It would be a once-in-a-lifetime experience that I would never forget.
questions.hint: Think about: Who works in the Oval Office? What important decisions are made there? What famous features does it have? How would you describe your emotions?

questions.question: Use the expression 'soak it all in' to describe a special moment in your life. What made it memorable?
questions.explanation: 考察学生能否在口语中正确运用'soak it all in'这一习语。该短语意为'充分感受、体验某个时刻'，常用于描述难得或特别的经历。
questions.referenceAnswer: I will never forget the day I graduated from high school. Walking across the stage to receive my diploma, I tried to soak it all in - the cheers from my family, the proud smiles of my teachers, and the feeling of accomplishment after years of hard work. I knew this was a once-in-a-lifetime moment, so I made sure to be fully present and appreciate every second of it.
questions.hint: Remember: 'soak it all in' means to fully experience and appreciate a moment. Describe when, where, who was with you, and why it was special.

questions.question: Imagine you are spending a day playing golf with your grandpa. Describe what activities you would do and how you would feel.
questions.explanation: 考察学生描述日常活动的能力，以及是否能运用相关英语表达。结合视频中与爷爷打高尔夫的场景，让学生展开想象并用英语描述类似经历。
questions.referenceAnswer: If I spent a day playing golf with my grandpa, I would wake up early and drive to the golf course with him. The weather might be a little cold, so I would bring an extra jacket. While playing, grandpa would teach me how to hold the club properly and how to read the greens. If I made a birdie, I would feel incredibly proud. After the game, we would go to the clubhouse for lunch and share stories. It would be a wonderful bonding experience that I would treasure forever.
questions.hint: Think about: What would you wear? What would the weather be like? What would you talk about? What if you scored well? Use words like 'golf course', 'birdie', and 'chilling'.

questions.question: The speaker says 'I'm exhausted, but gotta grind.' Tell me about a time when you were tired but still had to work hard. How did you stay motivated?
questions.explanation: 考察学生能否理解和运用'gotta grind'这一口语表达，意思是'必须努力'。让学生结合个人经历谈论坚持和努力的主题。
questions.referenceAnswer: Last week, I had a major exam the next day, but I was exhausted from a full day of classes. I told myself, 'I'm exhausted, but gotta grind.' I made myself a cup of coffee, put on some focus music, and reviewed my notes for three hours. To stay motivated, I reminded myself of my goal to get into a good university. When I finally finished studying and went to bed, I felt proud of myself for pushing through the tiredness. The next day, I did well on the exam, and all that hard work paid off.
questions.hint: Structure: 1) The situation 2) Why you were tired 3) How you kept going 4) The result. Use phrases like 'push through', 'stay focused', 'it's worth it'.

questions.question: The speaker enjoyed 'sitting out here' and chilling. Describe your ideal relaxing moment. Where would you be, and what would you be doing?
questions.explanation: 考察学生描述放松场景的能力，结合视频中放松享受的语境。让学生用英语表达个人偏好和生活方式。
questions.referenceAnswer: My ideal relaxing moment would be sitting on a comfortable chair in my backyard on a sunny afternoon. I would have a cold root beer in my hand, listening to my favorite playlist. Sometimes I would read a good book, and other times I would just close my eyes and listen to the birds singing. There's no phone, no homework, and no stress - just me enjoying the simple pleasures of life. These moments help me recharge and feel ready to take on new challenges.
questions.hint: Think about: Where is your favorite place to relax? What do you drink? What sounds do you hear? Do you read, listen to music, or just think? Use present continuous tense.
